# ========== MULTI-TOKEN STATE ==========
active_clients = {} 
multi_counter_value = 0
multi_counter_active = False
stam_counter = 0
multi_gc_counter = 0

def get_target_clients(msg):
    if msg.mentions:
        mentioned_ids = {m.id for m in msg.mentions}
        return [inst for inst in active_clients.values() if inst.client.user.id in mentioned_ids]
    return list(active_clients.values())

# ========== CLIENT MANAGER ==========
class TeckClient:
    def __init__(self, token, is_main=False):
        self.token = token
        self.is_main = is_main
        self.spam_task = None
        self.gc_task = None
        self.multi_gc_task = None
        self.status_task = None
        self.ab_task = None
        self.ab_low_task = None
        self.paster_task = None
        self.paster_active = False
        
        # React dicts
        self.auto_react = {}      # {user_id: emoji}
        self.mreact_targets = {}  # {user_id: [emoji1, emoji2]}
        self.creact_targets = {}  # {user_id: {"emojis": [...], "index": 0}}
        
        self.rizz_set = set()
        self.autoreply_targets = {}
        self.anti_gc_enabled = False
        self.start_time = time.time()
        self.gc_active = False
        self.ab_active = False
        self.ab_low_active = False
        self.current_page = {}
        self.multi_paster_task = None
        self.multi_reply_targets = {}
        self.multi_spam_task = None
        self.counter_task = None
        self.multi_counter_task = None
        self.stam_task = None
        self.pollspam_task = None
        self.pinspam_task = None
        self.poll_text = "SHUT THE FUCK UP"
        
        self.client = Client(max_messages=10)
        self.http_client = httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=10.0)
        self.sem = asyncio.Semaphore(CONCURRENT_REQUESTS)

    async def stop_all(self):
        global multi_counter_active
        self.ab_active = False
        self.ab_low_active = False
        self.gc_active = False
        self.paster_active = False
        multi_counter_active = False
        
        for t in [self.spam_task, self.gc_task, self.multi_gc_task, self.status_task, self.ab_task, self.ab_low_task, self.paster_task, self.multi_paster_task, self.multi_spam_task, self.counter_task, self.multi_counter_task, self.stam_task, self.pollspam_task, self.pinspam_task]:
            if t:
                t.cancel()
                
        self.spam_task = None
        self.gc_task = None
        self.multi_gc_task = None
        self.status_task = None
        self.ab_task = None
        self.ab_low_task = None
        self.paster_task = None
        self.multi_paster_task = None
        self.multi_spam_task = None
        self.counter_task = None
        self.multi_counter_task = None
        self.stam_task = None
        self.pollspam_task = None
        self.pinspam_task = None
        
        self.autoreply_targets.clear()
        self.multi_reply_targets.clear()
        
        self.auto_react.clear()
        self.mreact_targets.clear()
        self.creact_targets.clear()
        self.rizz_set.clear()
        
        try:
            await self.client.change_presence(status=discord.Status.online, activity=None)
        except:
            pass

    async def safe_send(self, ch, msg):
        try:
            await ch.send(msg)
        except (aiohttp.ClientError, asyncio.TimeoutError, OSError):
            await asyncio.sleep(5)
        except Exception:
            pass

    async def safe_dm(self, user_id, msg):
        try:
            user = await self.client.fetch_user(user_id)
            if user:
                await user.send(msg)
        except:
            pass

    async def safe_react(self, msg, emoji, delay=True):
        try:
            await msg.add_reaction(emoji)
            if delay:
                await asyncio.sleep(0.3)
        except discord.HTTPException:
            pass

    async def do_ab(self, ch, base_delay):
        self.ab_active = True
        try:
            for i in range(MAX_BLAST_MESSAGES):
                if not self.ab_active: break
                await self.safe_send(ch, random.choice(autobeeferlist))
                if (i + 1) % 1000 == 0: print(f"[{self.client.user}] Blast: {i+1}/{MAX_BLAST_MESSAGES}")
                delay_variation = base_delay * 0.3
                actual_delay = base_delay + random.uniform(-delay_variation, delay_variation)
                if random.random() < 0.05: actual_delay += random.uniform(1.0, 3.0)
                await asyncio.sleep(actual_delay)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            pass

    async def do_ab_low(self, ch, base_delay):

        try:
            for i in range(MAX_BLAST_MESSAGES):
                if not self.ab_low_active: break

                if (i + 1) % 1000 == 0: print(f"[{self.client.user}] Blast-Low: {i+1}/{MAX_BLAST_MESSAGES}")
                delay_variation = base_delay * 0.3
                actual_delay = base_delay + random.uniform(-delay_variation, delay_variation)
                if random.random() < 0.05: actual_delay += random.uniform(1.0, 3.0)
                await asyncio.sleep(actual_delay)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            pass

    async def do_paster(self, ch, text, base_delay):
        self.paster_active = True
        count = 1
        try:
            while self.paster_active:
                await self.safe_send(ch, f"{text} ({count})")
                count += 1
                delay_variation = base_delay * 0.3
                actual_delay = base_delay + random.uniform(-delay_variation, delay_variation)
                if random.random() < 0.05: actual_delay += random.uniform(1.0, 3.0)
                await asyncio.sleep(actual_delay)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            pass

    async def do_multi_paster(self, ch_id, text, base_delay, targets):
        global multi_counter_value
        try:
            while True:
                if not targets: break
                for inst in targets:
                    ch = inst.client.get_channel(ch_id)
                    if ch:

                        actual_delay = base_delay + random.uniform(-delay_variation, delay_variation)
                        if random.random() < 0.05: actual_delay += random.uniform(1.0, 3.0)
                        await asyncio.sleep(actual_delay)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            pass

    async def do_counter(self, ch):
        count = 1
        try:
            while True:
                await self.safe_send(ch, f"```{count}```")
                count += 1
                await asyncio.sleep(1)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            pass

    async def do_multi_counter(self, ch_id, targets):
        global multi_counter_value, multi_counter_active
        multi_counter_active = True
        try:
            while multi_counter_active:
                sent_any = False
                if not targets: break
                for inst in targets:
                    if not multi_counter_active: break
                    multi_counter_value += 1
                    ch = inst.client.get_channel(ch_id)
                    if ch:
                        await inst.safe_send(ch, f"```{multi_counter_value}```")
                        sent_any = True
                        await asyncio.sleep(1)
                if not sent_any:
                    await asyncio.sleep(1)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            multi_counter_active = False

    async def cycle_names(self, gc, text, delay):
        self.gc_active = True
        count = 1
        try:
            while self.gc_active:
                try:
                    await gc.edit(name=f"{text} ({count})")
                    count += 1
                    await asyncio.sleep(delay)
                except (aiohttp.ClientError, asyncio.TimeoutError, OSError):
                    await asyncio.sleep(5)
                except Exception:
                    break
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            pass

    async def sequential_multi_gcname(self, gc_id, text, delay, targets):
        global multi_gc_counter
        try:
            while True:
                if not targets: break
                for inst in targets:
                    gc = inst.client.get_channel(gc_id)
                    if gc and isinstance(gc, GroupChannel):
                        multi_gc_counter += 1
                        try:
                            await gc.edit(name=f"{text} ({multi_gc_counter})")
                            await asyncio.sleep(delay)
                        except (aiohttp.ClientError, asyncio.TimeoutError, OSError):
                            await asyncio.sleep(5)
                        except Exception:
                            pass
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            pass

    # ========== SEQUENTIAL STAM ==========
    async def sequential_stam(self, ch_id, text, targets):
        global stam_counter
        try:
            while True:
                if not targets: break
                for inst in targets:
                    ch = inst.client.get_channel(ch_id)
                    if ch:
                        stam_counter += 1
                        await inst.safe_send(ch, f"{text} ({stam_counter})")
                        await asyncio.sleep(3.0 + random.uniform(-0.1, 0.1))
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            pass

    # ========== POLL SPAM LOGIC ==========
    async def send_api_poll(self, token, ch_id):
        poll_answers = [{"poll_media": {"text": "﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽﷽"}} for _ in range(10)]
        poll_data = {
            "mobile_network_type": "unknown",
            "content": "",
            "nonce": str(int(asyncio.get_event_loop().time() * 1000)),
            "tts": False,
            "flags": 0,
            "poll": {
                "question": {"text": self.poll_text},
                "answers": poll_answers,
                "allow_multiselect": False,
                "duration": 24,
                "layout_type": 1
            }
        }
        headers = {"Authorization": token, "Content-Type": "application/json"}
        url = f"{DISCORD_API}/channels/{ch_id}/messages"
        async with self.sem:
            try:
                resp = await self.http_client.post(url, headers=headers, json=poll_data)
                if resp.status_code in (200, 201):
                    return token, resp.json().get('id')
            except Exception:
                pass
        return token, None

    async def end_api_poll(self, token, ch_id, message_id):
        if not message_id: return
        url = f"{DISCORD_API}/channels/{ch_id}/polls/{message_id}/expire"
        headers = {"Authorization": token, "Content-Type": "application/json"}
        async with self.sem:
            try:
                await self.http_client.post(url, headers=headers)
            except Exception:
                pass

    async def do_pollspam(self, ch_id, delay, targets):
        try:
            while True:
                if not targets: break
                tasks = [self.send_api_poll(inst.token, ch_id) for inst in targets]
                results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
                await asyncio.sleep(1)
                end_tasks = [self.end_api_poll(inst.token, ch_id, msg_id) for inst, (_, msg_id) in zip(targets, results) if msg_id]
                if end_tasks: await asyncio.gather(*end_tasks)
                await asyncio.sleep(delay + random.uniform(-0.1, 0.1))
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            pass

    # ========== PIN SPAM LOGIC ==========
    async def pin_check_access(self, token, ch_id):
        headers = {"Authorization": token}
        url = f"{DISCORD_API}/channels/{ch_id}"
        try:
            resp = await self.http_client.get(url, headers=headers)
            return resp.status_code == 200
        except Exception:
            return False

    async def pin_get_pins(self, token, ch_id, pinned_set):
        headers = {"Authorization": token}
        url = f"{DISCORD_API}/channels/{ch_id}/pins"
        try:
            resp = await self.http_client.get(url, headers=headers)
            if resp.status_code == 200:
                for pin in resp.json():
                    pinned_set.add(pin['id'])
                print(f"[+] Found {len(pinned_set)} already pinned messages")
                return True
        except Exception:
            pass
        return False

    async def pin_get_messages(self, token, ch_id, before=None, after=None):
        headers = {"Authorization": token}
        url = f"{DISCORD_API}/channels/{ch_id}/messages"
        params = {"limit": 100}
        if before: params["before"] = before
        if after: params["after"] = after
        try:
            resp = await self.http_client.get(url, headers=headers, params=params)
            if resp.status_code == 200: return resp.json()
        except Exception:
            pass
        return []

    async def pin_get_all_messages(self, token, ch_id):
        print(f"[+] Fetching ALL messages from channel...")
        all_messages = []
        last_message_id = None
        batch_count = 0
        while True:
            messages = await self.pin_get_messages(token, ch_id, before=last_message_id)
            if not messages: break
            all_messages.extend(messages)
            last_message_id = messages[-1]['id']
            batch_count += 1
            print(f"[+] Batch {batch_count}: Fetched {len(messages)} messages (Total: {len(all_messages)})")
            if len(messages) < 100: break
            await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
        print(f"[+] TOTAL MESSAGES FOUND: {len(all_messages)}")
        return all_messages

    async def pin_message_api(self, token, ch_id, message_id):
        headers = {"Authorization": token, "Content-Type": "application/json"}
        url = f"{DISCORD_API}/channels/{ch_id}/pins/{message_id}"
        try:
            resp = await self.http_client.put(url, headers=headers)
            if resp.status_code == 204: return True, None
            elif resp.status_code == 429: return False, resp.json().get('retry_after', 5)
            elif resp.status_code == 403: return False, "no_permission"
            elif resp.status_code == 404: return False, "message_not_found"
            else: return False, f"error_{resp.status_code}"
        except Exception as e:
            return False, str(e)

    async def pin_all_messages(self, valid_tokens, ch_id, messages, pinned_set, delay):
        if not messages:
            print(f"[!] No messages to pin"); return
        print(f"[+] Starting pin operation...")
        pinned_count, skipped_count, token_index = 0, 0, 0
        
        for i, message in enumerate(messages, 1):
            message_id = message['id']
            if message_id in pinned_set:
                skipped_count += 1
                continue
                
            token = valid_tokens[token_index % len(valid_tokens)]
            success, error = await self.pin_message_api(token, ch_id, message_id)
            
            if success:
                pinned_set.add(message_id); pinned_count += 1; token_index += 1
                print(f"[+] Pinned: {message_id} ({i}/{len(messages)})")
                await asyncio.sleep(delay)
            elif error == "no_permission":
                token_index += 1; await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
                if token_index < len(valid_tokens):
                    new_token = valid_tokens[token_index % len(valid_tokens)]
                    retry_success, _ = await self.pin_message_api(new_token, ch_id, message_id)
                    if retry_success: pinned_set.add(message_id); pinned_count += 1; print(f"[+] Pinned: {message_id}")
            elif isinstance(error, (int, float)):
                await asyncio.sleep(error)
                retry_success, _ = await self.pin_message_api(token, ch_id, message_id)
                if retry_success: pinned_set.add(message_id); pinned_count += 1; print(f"[+] Pinned: {message_id}")
                await asyncio.sleep(delay)
            
            if i % 50 == 0: print(f"[+] Progress: {i}/{len(messages)} | Pinned: {pinned_count} | Skipped: {skipped_count}")
                
        print(f"\n[+] INITIAL PIN COMPLETE | Total: {len(messages)} | Newly Pinned: {pinned_count} | Skipped: {skipped_count}")

    async def pin_monitor(self, valid_tokens, ch_id, last_message_id, pinned_set, delay):
        print(f"[+] Monitoring for new messages...")
        token_index = 0
        try:
            while True:
                messages = await self.pin_get_messages(valid_tokens[0], ch_id, after=last_message_id)
                if messages:
                    messages.reverse()
                    for message in messages:
                        message_id = message['id']
                        if message_id in pinned_set: continue
                        
                        token = valid_tokens[token_index % len(valid_tokens)]
                        success, error = await self.pin_message_api(token, ch_id, message_id)
                        if success:
                            pinned_set.add(message_id); token_index += 1
                            print(f"[+] Pinned new: {message_id}")
                            await asyncio.sleep(delay)
                        elif isinstance(error, (int, float)):
                            await asyncio.sleep(error)
                        else:
                            token_index += 1; await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
                            
                    if messages: last_message_id = messages[-1]['id']
                await asyncio.sleep(5)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            pass

    async def do_pinspam(self, ch_id, delay, targets):
        valid_tokens = []
        if not targets: return
        
        print(f"[+] Validating tokens for pin spam...")
        for inst in targets:
            if await self.pin_check_access(inst.token, ch_id):
                valid_tokens.append(inst.token)
        
        if not valid_tokens:
            print(f"[!] No valid tokens with access to channel {ch_id}"); return
            
        print(f"[+] Valid tokens for pinning: {len(valid_tokens)}")
        pinned_messages = set()
        
        await self.pin_get_pins(valid_tokens[0], ch_id, pinned_messages)
        messages = await self.pin_get_all_messages(valid_tokens[0], ch_id)
        await self.pin_all_messages(valid_tokens, ch_id, messages, pinned_messages, delay)
        
        last_id = messages[0]['id'] if messages else None
        await self.pin_monitor(valid_tokens, ch_id, last_id, pinned_messages, delay)

    # =====================================

    async def cache_sweeper(self):
        while True:
            await asyncio.sleep(60)
            try:
                if hasattr(self.client, 'users') and len(self.client.users) > 50:
                    self.client.users._cache.clear()
                for guild in self.client.guilds:
                    for channel in guild.text_channels:
                        if hasattr(channel, '_message_cache'):
                            while len(channel._message_cache) > 5:
                                channel._message_cache.popitem(last=False)
            except Exception:
                pass

    async def on_ready(self):
        print(f"Logged in as {self.client.user} | Teck Ready")
        asyncio.create_task(self.cache_sweeper())

    async def on_message(self, msg):
        global active_clients, multi_counter_value, multi_counter_active, stam_counter, multi_gc_counter
        c = self.client

        if self.anti_gc_enabled:
            if isinstance(msg.channel, GroupChannel):
                if msg.type == discord.MessageType.recipient_add:
                    if msg.mentions and c.user in msg.mentions:
                        try:
                            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "YOU CANT TRAP A GOD LMFAOOOOOOOOOOOO")
                            for _ in range(3):
                                await msg.channel.edit(name="ANTI-GC TRAPPED LMFAO")
                                await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
                            await msg.channel.leave(silent=True)
                            print(f"[{self.client.user}] Anti-GC triggered: Left a GC trap silently")
                        except Exception as e:
                            print(f"Anti-GC Error: {e}")

        # ========== REACTIONS & RIZZ (MUST BE BEFORE RETURN) ==========
        if msg.author != c.user:
            if msg.author.id in self.auto_react:
                await self.safe_react(msg, self.auto_react[msg.author.id])
                
            if msg.author.id in self.mreact_targets:
                for emoji in self.mreact_targets[msg.author.id]:
                    await self.safe_react(msg, emoji, delay=True)

            if msg.author.id in self.creact_targets:
                data = self.creact_targets.get(msg.author.id)
                if data:
                    emoji = data["emojis"][data["index"]]
                    await self.safe_react(msg, emoji, delay=False)
                    data["index"] = (data["index"] + 1) % len(data["emojis"])

            if msg.author.id in self.rizz_set:
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, random.choice(rizz_lines))

        # ========== AUTO REPLIES ==========
        if msg.author != c.user:
            if msg.author.id in self.autoreply_targets:
                reply_text = self.autoreply_targets[msg.author.id]
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"{msg.author.mention} {reply_text}")
                await self.safe_dm(msg.author.id, reply_text)

            if msg.author.id in self.multi_reply_targets:
                reply_text = self.multi_reply_targets[msg.author.id]
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"{msg.author.mention} {reply_text}")
                await self.safe_dm(msg.author.id, reply_text)
            return # Return here so bot ignores commands from others

        cmd = msg.content.strip().lower()
        parts = msg.content.strip().split()
        if not parts: return
        action = parts[0]

        if cmd == ".menu":
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, ascii_art)
            self.current_page[msg.channel.id] = 0
            return
        if cmd == ".next":
            page = self.current_page.get(msg.channel.id, 0)
            pages = [page1, page2, page3, page4, page5]
            page = page + 1
            if page > len(pages): page = len(pages)
            self.current_page[msg.channel.id] = page
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, pages[page - 1])
            return
        if cmd == ".prev":
            page = self.current_page.get(msg.channel.id, 1)
            pages = [page1, page2, page3, page4, page5]
            page = page - 1
            if page < 1: page = 1
            self.current_page[msg.channel.id] = page
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, pages[page - 1])
            return

        if action.startswith('.') and action[1:] in gif_links:
            if msg.mentions:
                target = msg.mentions[0].mention
                gif = random.choice(gif_links[action[1:]])
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"*{c.user.mention} {action[1:]}s {target}* 💥\n{gif}")
            else:
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"Usage: {action} @user")
            return

        if cmd.startswith(".flirt"):
            if msg.mentions:
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"{msg.mentions[0].mention} {random.choice(flirt_lines)}")
            else:
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "Usage: .flirt @user")
            return

        # ========== TOKEN MANAGEMENT ==========
        if cmd.startswith(".addtoken") and self.is_main and len(parts) >= 2:
            new_token = parts[1]
            if new_token in active_clients:
                return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ Token is already running")
            asyncio.create_task(start_bot(new_token))
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "✅ Starting new token in background...")
            return

        if cmd == ".listtoken":
            if not active_clients:
                return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "No extra tokens running")
            token_list = "\n".join([f"• {inst.client.user.name} ({inst.client.user.id})" for inst in active_clients.values()])
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"```Running Tokens ({len(active_clients)}):\n{token_list}```")
            return

        if cmd.startswith(".removetoken") and self.is_main and len(parts) >= 2:
            target_id = parts[1]
            target_token = None
            for token, inst in active_clients.items():
                if str(inst.client.user.id) == target_id:
                    target_token = token
                    break
            if target_token:
                inst = active_clients[target_token]
                await inst.stop_all()
                await inst.client.close()
                del active_clients[target_token]
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"✅ Stopped and removed token: {target_id}")
            else:
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ Token ID not found in active clients")
            return

        if cmd == ".killall":
            for inst in active_clients.values():
                await inst.stop_all()
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "🛑 All tasks on ALL tokens killed")
            return

        # ========== EXPLICIT STOP COMMANDS ==========
        if cmd == ".autoreact stop":
            self.auto_react.clear()
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "🛑 autoreact cleared")
        elif cmd == ".mreact stop":
            if msg.mentions:
                target_id = msg.mentions[0].id
                if self.mreact_targets.pop(target_id, None):
                    await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"🛑 Stopped multi-reacting to {msg.mentions[0].mention}")
                else:
                    await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ That user wasn't in `.mreact` list.")
            else:
                self.mreact_targets.clear()
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "🛑 All mreacts cleared")
        elif cmd == ".creact stop":
            if msg.mentions:
                target_id = msg.mentions[0].id
                if self.creact_targets.pop(target_id, None):
                    await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"🛑 Stopped cycling reacts for {msg.mentions[0].mention}")
                else:
                    await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ That user wasn't in `.creact` list.")
            else:
                self.creact_targets.clear()
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "🛑 All creacts cleared")
        elif cmd == ".autoreply stop":
            self.autoreply_targets.clear()
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "🛑 autoreply off")
        elif cmd == ".multireply stop":
            for inst in active_clients.values():
                inst.multi_reply_targets.clear()
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "🛑 All tokens multireply off")
        elif cmd == ".rizzstop":
            self.rizz_set.clear()
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "🛑 rizz cleared")
        elif cmd == ".spam stop":
            if self.spam_task:
                self.spam_task.cancel()
                self.spam_task = None
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "🛑 spam stopped")
        elif cmd == ".stam stop":
            for inst in active_clients.values():
                if inst.stam_task: inst.stam_task.cancel(); inst.stam_task = None
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "🛑 stam stopped")
        elif cmd == ".pollspam stop":
            for inst in active_clients.values():
                if inst.pollspam_task: inst.pollspam_task.cancel(); inst.pollspam_task = None
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "🛑 pollspam stopped")
        elif cmd == ".pinspam stop":
            for inst in active_clients.values():
                if inst.pinspam_task: inst.pinspam_task.cancel(); inst.pinspam_task = None
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "🛑 pinspam stopped")
        elif cmd == ".ab stop":
            self.ab_active = False
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "🛑 ab stopped")
        elif cmd == ".ab-low stop":
            self.ab_low_active = False
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "🛑 ab-low stopped")
        elif cmd == ".pasterstop":
            self.paster_active = False
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "🛑 paster stopped")
        elif cmd == ".streamstop":
            if self.status_task:
                self.status_task.cancel()
                self.status_task = None
            await c.change_presence(status=discord.Status.online, activity=None)
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "🛑 stream/status stopped")
        elif cmd == ".counter stop":
            if self.counter_task:
                self.counter_task.cancel()
                self.counter_task = None
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "🛑 counter stopped")
        elif cmd == ".multicounter stop":
            multi_counter_value = 0
            multi_counter_active = False
            if self.multi_counter_task:
                self.multi_counter_task.cancel()
                self.multi_counter_task = None
            for inst in active_clients.values():
                if inst.multi_counter_task:
                    inst.multi_counter_task.cancel()
                    inst.multi_counter_task = None
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "🛑 multicounter stopped and reset")

        # ========== GENERAL COMMANDS ==========
        elif cmd == ".uptime":
            uptime = int(time.time() - self.start_time)
            h, m, s = uptime // 3600, (uptime % 3600) // 60, uptime % 60
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"uptime: {h}h {m}m {s}s")

        elif cmd.startswith(".paster") and len(parts) >= 3:
            try:
                ch_id = int(parts[1])
                if '"' in msg.content:
                    text = msg.content.split('"', 1)[1].rsplit('"', 1)[0]
                else:
                    text = " ".join(parts[2:])
                
                if not text:
                    return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ Message cannot be empty")

                target_ch = c.get_channel(ch_id)
                if not target_ch: return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ invalid channel id")
                
                self.paster_active = False
                if self.paster_task:
                    self.paster_task.cancel()
                await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
                
                self.paster_task = asyncio.create_task(self.do_paster(target_ch, text, 4.0))
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"✅ paster started in <#{ch_id}> (4s)")
            except ValueError:
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ invalid format. Usage: .paster <ch id> \"<msg>\"")

        elif cmd.startswith(".ab-low") and len(parts) >= 2 and parts[1] != "stop":
            try:
                ch_id = int(parts[1])
                delay = float(parts[2]) if len(parts) >= 3 else 4.0
                target_ch = c.get_channel(ch_id)
                if not target_ch: return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ invalid channel id")
                self.ab_low_active = False
                await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
                self.ab_low_task = asyncio.create_task(self.do_ab_low(target_ch, delay))
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"✅ ab-low started in <#{ch_id}> ({delay}s)")
            except ValueError:
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ invalid format")

        elif cmd.startswith(".ab") and len(parts) >= 2 and parts[1] != "stop":
            try:
                ch_id = int(parts[1])
                delay = float(parts[2]) if len(parts) >= 3 else 4.0
                target_ch = c.get_channel(ch_id)
                if not target_ch: return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ invalid channel id")
                self.ab_active = False
                await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
                self.ab_task = asyncio.create_task(self.do_ab(target_ch, delay))
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"✅ ab started in <#{ch_id}> ({delay}s)")
            except ValueError:
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ invalid format")

        elif cmd.startswith(".autoreact") and len(parts) >= 3 and msg.mentions:
            emoji = parts[2]
            self.auto_react[msg.mentions[0].id] = emoji
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"✅ autoreact {emoji} on {msg.mentions[0].mention}")

        elif cmd.startswith(".mreact") and len(parts) >= 3 and msg.mentions:
            emojis = parts[2].split(',')
            target_id = msg.mentions[0].id
            self.mreact_targets[target_id] = emojis
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"✅ mreact on {msg.mentions[0].mention}: {', '.join(emojis)}")

        elif cmd.startswith(".creact") and len(parts) >= 3 and msg.mentions:
            emojis = parts[2].split(',')
            target_id = msg.mentions[0].id
            self.creact_targets[target_id] = {"emojis": emojis, "index": 0}
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"✅ creact on {msg.mentions[0].mention}: {', '.join(emojis)}")

        elif cmd.startswith(".autoreply") and msg.mentions:
            target_id = msg.mentions[0].id
            if target_id in self.autoreply_targets:
                del self.autoreply_targets[target_id]
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"❌ autoreply off {msg.mentions[0].mention}")
            else:
                if '"' in msg.content:
                    text = msg.content.split('"', 1)[1].rsplit('"', 1)[0]
                else:
                    text = " ".join(parts[2:])
                
                if not text:
                    return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ Usage: .autoreply @user \"<msg>\"")
                    
                self.autoreply_targets[target_id] = text
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"✅ autoreply on {msg.mentions[0].mention}: {text} (Triggers on user message)")

        elif cmd.startswith(".rizz") and msg.mentions:
            target = msg.mentions[0].id
            if target in self.rizz_set:
                self.rizz_set.discard(target)
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"❌ rizz off {msg.mentions[0].mention}")
            else:
                self.rizz_set.add(target)
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"✅ rizz on {msg.mentions[0].mention}")

        elif cmd.startswith(".spam") and len(parts) >= 4 and parts[1] != "stop":
            try:
                delay = float(parts[1])
                if '"' in msg.content:
                    text = msg.content.split('"', 1)[1].rsplit('"', 1)[0]
                    remainder = msg.content.rsplit('"', 1)[1].strip().split()
                    if not remainder:
                        return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ Format: .spam <delay> \"<msg>\" <ch id>")
                    ch_id = int(remainder[0])
                else:
                    text_parts = []
                    text_idx = 2
                    while text_idx < len(parts):
                        try:
                            int(parts[text_idx])
                            break
                        except ValueError:
                            text_parts.append(parts[text_idx])
                            text_idx += 1
                    
                    if len(parts) - text_idx < 1:
                        return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ Format: .spam <delay> \"<msg>\" <ch id>")
                    
                    text = " ".join(text_parts)
                    ch_id = int(parts[text_idx])
                
                if not text:
                    return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ Message cannot be empty")
                    
                target_ch = c.get_channel(ch_id)
                if not target_ch: return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ invalid channel id")
                
                if self.spam_task:
                    self.spam_task.cancel()
                async def spam_loop():
                    while True:
                        await self.safe_send(target_ch, text)
                        await asyncio.sleep(delay + random.uniform(-0.1, 0.1))
                self.spam_task = asyncio.create_task(spam_loop())
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"✅ spamming every {delay}s in <#{ch_id}>")
            except: 
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ Format: .spam <delay> \"<msg>\" <ch id>")

        elif cmd.startswith(".stam") and len(parts) >= 2 and parts[1].lower() != "stop":
            try:
                if '"' in msg.content:
                    text = msg.content.split('"', 1)[1].rsplit('"', 1)[0]
                else:
                    text = " ".join(parts[1:])
                
                if not text:
                    return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ Message cannot be empty")
                
                stam_counter = 0
                targets = get_target_clients(msg)
                
                for inst in active_clients.values():
                    if inst.stam_task: inst.stam_task.cancel()
                for inst in targets:
                    inst.stam_task = asyncio.create_task(inst.sequential_stam(msg.channel.id, text, targets))
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"✅ stamming sequentially (3s delay) with {len(targets)} tokens")
            except: 
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, '❌ Format: .stam "<msg>" [@user1 @user2]')

        elif cmd.startswith(".pollspam") and len(parts) >= 2 and parts[1].lower() != "stop":
            try:
                delay = float(parts[1])
                if '"' in msg.content:
                    text = msg.content.split('"', 1)[1].rsplit('"', 1)[0]
                    if text: self.poll_text = text
                elif len(parts) >= 3: 
                    self.poll_text = " ".join(parts[2:])
                
                targets = get_target_clients(msg)
                
                for inst in active_clients.values():
                    if inst.pollspam_task: inst.pollspam_task.cancel()
                for inst in targets:
                    inst.pollspam_task = asyncio.create_task(inst.do_pollspam(msg.channel.id, delay, targets))
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"✅ pollspamming every {delay}s (Msg: {self.poll_text}) with {len(targets)} tokens")
            except: 
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, '❌ Format: .pollspam <delay> "<msg>" [@user1 @user2]')

        elif cmd.startswith(".pinspam") and len(parts) >= 3 and parts[1].lower() != "stop":
            try:
                delay = float(parts[1])
                ch_id = int(parts[2])
                targets = get_target_clients(msg)
                
                for inst in active_clients.values():
                    if inst.pinspam_task: inst.pinspam_task.cancel()
                for inst in targets:
                    inst.pinspam_task = asyncio.create_task(inst.do_pinspam(ch_id, delay, targets))
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"✅ pinspam started in <#{ch_id}> ({delay}s delay) with {len(targets)} tokens")
            except ValueError:
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ Format: .pinspam <delay> <ch id> [@user1 @user2] | .pinspam stop")

        elif cmd.startswith(".gcname"):
            sub = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else None
            if sub == "stop":
                self.gc_active = False
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "🛑 gc names stopped")
            elif sub == "start" and len(parts) >= 2:
                if isinstance(msg.channel, GroupChannel):
                    if '"' in msg.content:
                        text = msg.content.split('"', 1)[1].rsplit('"', 1)[0]
                        remainder = msg.content.rsplit('"', 1)[1].strip().split()
                        delay = float(remainder[0]) if remainder else 3.0
                    else:
                        text = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else "TECK"
                        delay = float(parts[3]) if len(parts) > 3 else 3.0
                        
                    if not text:
                        return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, '❌ Format: .gcname start "<msg>" <delay>')
                        
                    self.gc_active = False
                    if self.gc_task:
                        self.gc_task.cancel()
                    self.gc_task = asyncio.create_task(self.cycle_names(msg.channel, text, delay))
                    await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"✅ gc name cycling ({delay}s delay)")
                else: 
                    await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ not a gc")

        elif cmd.startswith(".stream1") and len(parts) > 1:
            text = " ".join(parts[1:])
            await c.change_presence(activity=discord.Streaming(name=text, url="https://twitch.tv/teck"))
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"✅ streaming: {text}")
            
        elif cmd.startswith(".stream2") and len(parts) > 1:
            text = " ".join(parts[1:])
            await c.change_presence(activity=discord.Activity(type=4, name=text))
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"✅ custom status: {text}")

        elif cmd.startswith(".antigc"):
            sub = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else None
            if sub == "on":
                self.anti_gc_enabled = True
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "✅ antigc on (Auto-leaves silently when added)")
            elif sub == "off":
                self.anti_gc_enabled = False
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ antigc off")

        elif cmd == ".leaveallgcs":
            for gc in c.private_channels:
                if isinstance(gc, GroupChannel):
                    try: await gc.leave(silent=True)
                    except: pass
            await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "✅ left all gcs")

        elif cmd.startswith(".counter") and len(parts) >= 2 and parts[1] != "stop":
            try:
                ch_id = int(parts[1])
                target_ch = c.get_channel(ch_id)
                if not target_ch: return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ invalid channel id")
                if self.counter_task:
                    self.counter_task.cancel()
                self.counter_task = asyncio.create_task(self.do_counter(target_ch))
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"✅ counter started in <#{ch_id}> (1s)")
            except ValueError:
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ Format: .counter <channel id> | .counter stop")

        elif cmd.startswith(".multicounter") and len(parts) >= 2 and parts[1] != "stop":
            try:
                ch_id = int(parts[1])
                target_ch = c.get_channel(ch_id)
                if not target_ch: return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ invalid channel id")
                multi_counter_value = 0
                multi_counter_active = False
                if self.multi_counter_task:
                    self.multi_counter_task.cancel()
                
                targets = get_target_clients(msg)
                self.multi_counter_task = asyncio.create_task(self.do_multi_counter(ch_id, targets))
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"✅ multicounter started in <#{ch_id}> with {len(targets)} tokens (1s)")
            except ValueError:
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ Format: .multicounter <channel id> [@user1 @user2] | .multicounter stop")

        # ========== MULTI-TOKEN COMMANDS ==========
        elif cmd.startswith(".multipaster") and len(parts) >= 2:
            try:
                if parts[1] == "stop":
                    for inst in active_clients.values():
                        if inst.multi_paster_task:
                            inst.multi_paster_task.cancel()
                            inst.multi_paster_task = None
                    return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "🛑 All tokens multipaster stopped")
                    
                if '"' in msg.content:
                    text = msg.content.split('"', 1)[1].rsplit('"', 1)[0]
                    remainder = msg.content.rsplit('"', 1)[1].strip().split()
                    if len(remainder) < 2:
                        return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ Format: .multipaster \"<msg>\" <ch id> <delay> [@user1 @user2]")
                    ch_id = int(remainder[0])
                    delay = float(remainder[1])
                else:
                    if len(parts) < 4:
                        return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ Format: .multipaster \"<msg>\" <ch id> <delay> [@user1 @user2]")
                    text_parts = []
                    text_idx = 1
                    while text_idx < len(parts):
                        try:
                            int(parts[text_idx])
                            break
                        except ValueError:
                            text_parts.append(parts[text_idx])
                            text_idx += 1
                    text = " ".join(text_parts)
                    if len(parts) - text_idx < 2:
                        return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ Format: .multipaster \"<msg>\" <ch id> <delay> [@user1 @user2]")
                    ch_id = int(parts[text_idx])
                    delay = float(parts[text_idx + 1])

                targets = get_target_clients(msg)
                for inst in targets:
                    if inst.multi_paster_task:
                        inst.multi_paster_task.cancel()
                    inst.multi_paster_task = asyncio.create_task(inst.do_multi_paster(ch_id, text, delay, targets))
                
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"✅ {len(targets)} tokens pasting sequentially in <#{ch_id}> ({delay}s)")
            except ValueError:
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ Format: .multipaster \"<msg>\" <ch id> <delay> [@user1 @user2]")

        elif cmd.startswith(".multireply") and len(parts) >= 2:
            try:
                if parts[1] == "stop":
                    for inst in active_clients.values():
                        inst.multi_reply_targets.clear()
                    return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "🛑 All tokens multireply stopped")
                    
                if '"' in msg.content:
                    text = msg.content.split('"', 1)[1].rsplit('"', 1)[0]
                    remainder = msg.content.rsplit('"', 1)[1].strip().split()
                    if not remainder:
                        return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ Format: .multireply \"<msg>\" <user id>")
                    user_id = int(remainder[0])
                else:
                    if len(parts) < 3:
                        return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ Format: .multireply \"<msg>\" <user id>")
                    text_parts = []
                    text_idx = 1
                    while text_idx < len(parts):
                        try:
                            int(parts[text_idx])
                            break
                        except ValueError:
                            text_parts.append(parts[text_idx])
                            text_idx += 1
                    text = " ".join(text_parts)
                    if len(parts) - text_idx < 1:
                        return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ Format: .multireply \"<msg>\" <user id>")
                    user_id = int(parts[text_idx])
                
                targets = get_target_clients(msg)
                for inst in targets:
                    inst.multi_reply_targets[user_id] = text
                
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"✅ {len(targets)} tokens replying to <@{user_id}>: {text} (Triggers on user message)")
            except ValueError:
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ Format: .multireply \"<msg>\" <user id> [@user1 @user2]")

        elif cmd.startswith(".multispam") and len(parts) >= 2:
            try:
                if parts[1] == "stop":
                    for inst in active_clients.values():
                        if inst.multi_spam_task:
                            inst.multi_spam_task.cancel()
                            inst.multi_spam_task = None
                    return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "🛑 All tokens multispam stopped")
                    
                if '"' in msg.content:
                    text = msg.content.split('"', 1)[1].rsplit('"', 1)[0]
                    remainder = msg.content.rsplit('"', 1)[1].strip().split()
                    if len(remainder) < 2:
                        return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ Format: .multispam \"<msg>\" <delay> <ch id> [@user1 @user2]")
                    delay = float(remainder[0])
                    ch_id = int(remainder[1])
                else:
                    if len(parts) < 4:
                        return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ Format: .multispam \"<msg>\" <delay> <ch id> [@user1 @user2]")
                    text_parts = []
                    text_idx = 1
                    while text_idx < len(parts):
                        try:
                            float(parts[text_idx])
                            break
                        except ValueError:
                            text_parts.append(parts[text_idx])
                            text_idx += 1
                    text = " ".join(text_parts)
                    if len(parts) - text_idx < 2:
                        return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ Format: .multispam \"<msg>\" <delay> <ch id> [@user1 @user2]")
                    delay = float(parts[text_idx])
                    ch_id = int(parts[text_idx + 1])

                targets = get_target_clients(msg)
                for inst in targets:
                    if inst.multi_spam_task:
                        inst.multi_spam_task.cancel()
                    inst.multi_spam_task = asyncio.create_task(inst.do_multi_spam(ch_id, text, delay, targets))
                
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"✅ {len(targets)} tokens spamming in <#{ch_id}> ({delay}s)")
            except ValueError:
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ Format: .multispam \"<msg>\" <delay> <ch id> [@user1 @user2]")

        elif cmd.startswith(".multigcname") and len(parts) >= 2:
            sub = parts[1]
            if sub == "start":
                if isinstance(msg.channel, GroupChannel):
                    if '"' in msg.content:
                        text = msg.content.split('"', 1)[1].rsplit('"', 1)[0]
                        remainder = msg.content.rsplit('"', 1)[1].strip().split()
                        delay = float(remainder[0]) if remainder else 3.0
                    else:
                        text = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else "TECK"
                        delay = float(parts[3]) if len(parts) > 3 else 3.0
                        
                    if not text:
                        return await self.safe_send(msg.channel, '❌ Format: .multigcname start "<msg>" <delay> [@user1 @user2]')
                        
                    targets = get_target_clients(msg)
                    for inst in targets:
                        if inst.multi_gc_task:
                            inst.multi_gc_task.cancel()
                            inst.multi_gc_task = None
                            
                    multi_gc_counter = 0
                    
                    self.multi_gc_task = asyncio.create_task(self.sequential_multi_gcname(msg.channel.id, text, delay, targets))
                    await self.safe_send(msg.channel, f"✅ {len(targets)} tokens cycling gc names sequentially ({delay}s delay)")
                else: 
                    await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "❌ not a gc")
            elif sub == "stop":
                for inst in active_clients.values():
                    if inst.multi_gc_task:
                        inst.multi_gc_task.cancel()
                        inst.multi_gc_task = None
                await self.safe_send(msg.channel, "🛑 All tokens multigcname stopped")


async def start_bot(token, is_main=False):
    if token in active_clients:
        return
    instance = TeckClient(token, is_main=is_main)
    active_clients[token] = instance 
    
    @instance.client.event
    async def on_ready():
        await instance.on_ready()
        
    @instance.client.event
    async def on_message(msg):
        await instance.on_message(msg)

    try:
        await instance.client.start(token)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Token failed: {e}")
        if token in active_clients:
            del active_clients[token]

async def main():
    if not MAIN_TOKEN:
        print("Error: MAIN_TOKEN is missing at the top of the script!")
        return
        
    await start_bot(MAIN_TOKEN, is_main=True)
    
    while True:
        await asyncio.sleep(60)

print("Starting Teck Multi-Token Enhanced...")
try:
    asyncio.run(main())
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")
